# Ka Ming Fung

### Notes on atmospheric science, forecasting, and scientific computing

::: {.social-bar}
[GitHub](https://github.com/kamingfung){.social-btn target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kamingfung/){.social-btn target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
[X / Twitter](https://twitter.com/kamingfung){.social-btn target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
[Academic Archive](https://kamingfung.github.io/academic){.social-btn target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

I'm Victor, a data scientist. I write these as the course notes I wish I'd had: short
modules, in an order, each one saying what it assumes you already know. Atmospheric and
climate science first, because that was the Ph.D. at CUHK and the postdoc at MIT, then
forecasting and the tooling that makes either bearable. Older research papers live on my
[academic archive](https://kamingfung.github.io/academic).
:::
:::
